answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pearl of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The reef is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ferrous. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
